## Summary

This is a **known-method/source-status correction**, not a new mathematical solution.

- The negative-part valuation estimate is already explicit in Cheltsov–Fujita–Kishimoto–Okada (2023), Appendix B, published Lemma 27 (preprint Lemma 26), DOI [10.1017/nmj.2023.5](https://doi.org/10.1017/nmj.2023.5)
- Correct the original OWR valuation-domain typo: the divisor is over the surface S, not X, and restore the inherited Du Val hypothesis
- Give a self-contained componentwise log-canonical-threshold bound with the global/local distinction and finiteness justification
- Identify upstream record 30005796 as another extraction of the same question

## Scope and validation

Only `unsolved_math_prioritization/attempts/30005795/` changes. Central queue/state/catalogue files and historical reviews are untouched.

The full original OWR context, published prior lemma and author preprint were inspected. OWR p. 839 was visually checked. The pinned dataset's SHA-256 matches the repository manifest; no upstream prior report exists for this unique problem code. Duplicate PR/branch checks were repeated before creation.

One substantive known-proof reconstruction turn is recorded. Execution was gpt-6-astra at xhigh, not ultra. This draft is not a claim of a novel discovery, human peer review, or historical priority. No merge, release or outreach is requested.
